uncertainties: Purdue GIS is not a certified survey and publishes no positional accuracy or definition for its level/extrusion fields.
Two main stories and dormered attic are interpreted from an oblique 1965 photograph while GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts.
Eaves/ridge heights, precise roof geometry, facade rhythm and entry bearing remain estimates or unverified.
The 1929 archive finding aid does not identify an address or provide a view of the original photo; continuity with the current site is uncertain.
The original massing height was 16 m per manifest, but this was a legacy unverified height; the rebuilt roof ridge is estimated at 13.2 m from the historical photo and is not survey-confirmed.
The independent grader notes the modeled window surrounds are simpler than the louvered shutters visible in the yearbook image.
No georeferenced facade elevation establishes the portico/entrance compass bearing.
